_about: Joe's teams (D6). TEAM ids, not names - a name would re-resolve on every read and could silently pick a different school. Games involving these teams float to the top of the listing under a YOUR TEAMS rule. Edit this file to change the list; no code change is needed. Ids follow the team convention: nfl-{espnId}, mlb-{statsapiId}, nba-{TRICODE}, nhl-{nhlId}, cfb bare CFBD ints. NOTE these are TEAM ids - game ids differ, and NBA game ids are nba-{espnEventId}.
